cases.name: cursor-cup
cases.description: CUP absolute positioning to corners and center; cursor left mid-screen.

cases.name: cursor-relative
cases.description: CUU/CUD/CUF/CUB relative movement, including clamping at the top edge.

cases.name: cursor-save-restore-decsc
cases.description: DECSC/DECRC (ESC 7 / ESC 8) save-restore including SGR state.

cases.name: cursor-save-restore-ansi
cases.description: ANSI save/restore cursor (CSI s / CSI u), position only.

cases.name: sgr-16color
cases.description: Standard fg 30-37, bright fg 90-97, bg 40-47, bright bg 100-107.

cases.name: sgr-256color
cases.description: Indexed 256-color fg (38;5;n) and bg (48;5;n) samples from cube and grayscale ramp.

cases.name: sgr-truecolor
cases.description: 24-bit truecolor fg (38;2) and bg (48;2), including combined fg+bg.

cases.name: sgr-attributes
cases.description: Each attribute alone (bold, dim, italic, underline, blink, inverse, strikethrough) then explicit removal codes.

cases.name: sgr-combos
cases.description: Attribute+color combos with selective resets (24, 39, 49) rather than SGR 0.

cases.name: wrap-autowrap-on
cases.description: DECAWM on (default): 60 chars wrap across 40-col lines.

cases.name: wrap-autowrap-off
cases.description: DECAWM off (CSI ?7l): overflow overwrites the last column instead of wrapping.

cases.name: wrap-wide-at-edge
cases.description: Wide CJK char that does not fit in the last column wraps whole to the next line.

cases.name: scroll-region-lf
cases.description: DECSTBM 3;10 with LF-driven scrolling inside the region; outside rows untouched.

cases.name: scroll-region-ri
cases.description: RI (ESC M) at the top of a DECSTBM region scrolls the region down.

cases.name: ed-clear-below-above
cases.description: Fill screen, then ED 1 (above+left) at 6;40 and ED 0 (below+right) at 18;40.

cases.name: ed-clear-all
cases.description: Fill screen then ED 2; cursor position must survive; marker drawn after.

cases.name: el-clears
cases.description: EL 0 (right), EL 1 (left, incl. cursor cell), EL 2 (whole line) on three filled rows.

cases.name: altscreen-roundtrip
cases.description: Enter 1049 alt screen, draw, exit; main screen content and cursor restored.

cases.name: altscreen-active
cases.description: Enter 1049 alt screen and stay there; altScreen flag true, alt content visible.

cases.name: il-dl
cases.description: IL (CSI L) inserts blank lines pushing content down; DL (CSI M) deletes lines pulling up.

cases.name: ich-dch
cases.description: ICH (CSI @) inserts blanks shifting right; DCH (CSI P) deletes shifting left.

cases.name: tabs-hts-tbc
cases.description: Default 8-col tab stops; HTS sets custom stops; TBC 3 clears all (tab then jumps to last column).

cases.name: origin-mode-decom
cases.description: DECOM: CUP becomes relative to the DECSTBM region top; reset afterwards.

cases.name: reverse-index-top
cases.description: RI at the true top of the screen scrolls the whole screen down one line.

cases.name: wide-cjk
cases.description: Wide CJK glyphs interleaved with ASCII; continuation cells must be width-0.

cases.name: combining-chars
cases.description: Combining marks attach to the preceding cell; precomposed form on next row for comparison.

cases.name: osc-title
cases.description: OSC 2 (BEL-terminated) then OSC 0 (ST-terminated); final title wins.

cases.name: pending-wrap-defer
cases.description: Fill exactly one row: wrap is deferred, cursor reports last column, next row untouched.

cases.name: pending-wrap-write
cases.description: Printable after a pending wrap triggers the deferred wrap to row 2 col 1.

cases.name: pending-wrap-cr
cases.description: CR cancels a pending wrap: next char overwrites row 1 col 1, no wrap occurs.

cases.name: pending-wrap-cub
cases.description: CUB from the pending-wrap state moves off the last column and cancels the wrap.

cases.name: pending-wrap-el
cases.description: EL 0 in the pending-wrap state erases from the last column; wrap stays cancelled for the next char.

cases.name: pending-wrap-cup
cases.description: Explicit CUP cancels a pending wrap; the next char lands at the addressed cell.

cases.name: decaln-fill
cases.description: DECALN (ESC # 8) fills the whole screen with E; drawing afterwards overwrites normally.

cases.name: decaln-resets-margins
cases.description: DECALN resets DECSTBM margins and homes the cursor: an LF at the true bottom scrolls the full screen.

cases.name: ech-erase
cases.description: ECH (CSI X) erases n cells at the cursor without moving it; count clamps at end of line.

cases.name: bce-el-bg
cases.description: Background color erase: EL fills erased cells with the active SGR background.

cases.name: bce-ed-bg
cases.description: Background color erase: ED fills the cleared region with the active SGR background.

cases.name: su-sd-scroll
cases.description: SU (CSI S) and SD (CSI T) shift lines within the screen, then SU inside a DECSTBM region.

cases.name: rep-repeat
cases.description: REP (CSI b) repeats the preceding graphic character, inheriting current SGR attributes.

cases.name: il-dl-region-bounds
cases.description: IL outside a DECSTBM region is a no-op; IL at the region bottom and DL at the region top shift only region rows.

cases.name: nel-region-bottom
cases.description: NEL (ESC E) at the DECSTBM bottom scrolls the region and always performs a carriage return.

cases.name: decom-outside-region
cases.description: DECOM: CUP addressing a row beyond the region clamps to the region bottom (DEC STD-070).

cases.name: cursor-line-col-ops
cases.description: CNL (CSI E) and CPL (CSI F) move to column 1 of other lines; VPA (CSI d) and CHA (CSI G) address directly.

cases.name: hpa-column
cases.description: HPA (CSI `) addresses an absolute column on the current row.

cases.name: cht-cbt-tabs
cases.description: CHT (CSI I) jumps forward n tab stops; CBT (CSI Z) jumps backward.

cases.name: decscusr-styles
cases.description: DECSCUSR sequences change only cursor style/blink (v1.1 fields); the grid must be unaffected.

cases.name: wide-overwrite-half
cases.description: Overwriting either half of a wide char blanks the orphaned half instead of leaving torn cells.

cases.name: ich-wide-edge
cases.description: ICH that would push half a wide char past the right edge drops the whole glyph.

cases.name: combining-eol
cases.description: Combining marks attach to the last-column cell even in the pending-wrap state.

cases.name: emoji-width
cases.description: Emoji are width 2 under the Unicode 11 tables the web client ships (xterm's built-in default is width-1 Unicode 6).

cases.name: osc8-hyperlink
cases.description: OSC 8 hyperlinks: anchor text renders in-grid, no URL bytes leak; xterm.js additionally reports linked cells as underlined.

cases.name: osc52-clipboard
cases.description: OSC 52 (clipboard write) has no grid-observable effect; payload must not leak into the screen.

cases.name: osc1337-ignored
cases.description: iTerm2 proprietary OSC 1337 must be consumed cleanly by non-iTerm2 emulators; no payload leaks.

cases.name: ris-full-reset
cases.description: RIS (ESC c) clears the screen, homes the cursor, and resets margins, DECOM, and SGR; default tab stops return.

cases.name: scrollback-overflow
cases.description: More lines than rows: the viewport shows the tail; earlier lines move to scrollback.

cases.name: repaint-converge-a
cases.description: Full-redraw checkpoint replay converges: repaint tail after margin/SGR-heavy prefix.

cases.name: repaint-converge-b
cases.description: Full-redraw checkpoint replay converges: same repaint tail after scrolled/DECOM prefix.

equivalences.name: repaint-converge
equivalences.reason: a full-redraw checkpoint replay must produce identical grids regardless of prior screen state (reattach correctness)
